```{r gb-scaling-plot, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7, message = FALSE, echo=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

trace_file <- "~/data/projects/sceptre3/benchmarking/guide_assignment/outputs/gb_c1_full/trace.tsv"

# Nextflow durations look like "2h 43m 19s", "42.5s", "850ms"; returns seconds.
parse_duration <- function(x) {
  unit_sec <- c(d = 86400, h = 3600, m = 60, s = 1, ms = 0.001)
  vapply(strsplit(x, " "), function(parts) {
    num  <- as.numeric(sub("[a-z]+$", "", parts))
    unit <- sub("^[0-9.]+", "", parts)
    sum(num * unit_sec[unit])
  }, numeric(1))
}


# Nextflow memory looks like "3.5 GB", "617.4 MB" (binary units); returns GB.
parse_memory <- function(x) {
  unit_bytes <- c(B = 1, KB = 1024, MB = 1024^2, GB = 1024^3, TB = 1024^4)
  vapply(strsplit(x, " "), function(p) as.numeric(p[1]) * unit_bytes[[p[2]]],
         numeric(1)) / 1024^3
}

# Seconds -> "hh:mm:ss".
format_hms <- function(sec) {
  sec <- round(sec)
  sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", sec %/% 3600, (sec %% 3600) %/% 60, sec %% 60)
}

# Cells -> "11k", "130k" (two significant digits).
format_k <- function(n) paste0(signif(n / 1000, 2), "k")

# The real matrices end each ray; their tags carry no cell count.
real_cells <- c("gasperini" = 207324L, "replogle-rd7" = 616184L)

runs <- read.delim(trace_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  filter(status == "COMPLETED") |>
  transmute(
    method      = tolower(sub("_ASSIGN$", "", sub(".*:", "", process))),
    screen      = ifelse(grepl("gasperini", tag), "Gasperini-based", "Replogle-based"),
    data        = ifelse(tag %in% names(real_cells), "Real", "Simulated"),
    n_cells     = ifelse(tag %in% names(real_cells), real_cells[tag],
                         suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub(".*_c([0-9]+)$", "\\1", tag)))),
    runtime_sec = parse_duration(realtime),
    memory_gb   = parse_memory(peak_rss)
  )

runtime_breaks <- c(1, 10, 60, 600, 3600, 3 * 3600, 6 * 3600, 12 * 3600, 24 * 3600, 48 * 3600)

# One plot per screen and metric, so each screen gets its own x breaks. The
# y range is shared across screens so the two columns compare directly.
panel <- function(scr, y, y_scale) {
  d <- filter(runs, screen == scr)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = n_cells, y = .data[[y]], colour = method)) +
    geom_line(data = filter(d, data == "Simulated")) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = data), size = 2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Simulated = 16, Real = 4)) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = sort(unique(d$n_cells)), labels = format_k,
                  guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
    y_scale +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Method", shape = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
runtime_scale <- scale_y_log10(breaks = runtime_breaks, labels = format_hms,
                               limits = range(runs$runtime_sec))
memory_scale  <- scale_y_log10(limits = range(runs$memory_gb))

screens <- c("Gasperini-based", "Replogle-based")
p_runtime <- lapply(screens, function(s)
  panel(s, "runtime_sec", runtime_scale) + labs(title = s))
p_memory  <- lapply(screens, function(s)
  panel(s, "memory_gb", memory_scale) +
    labs(x = "Cells (guides scaled at the real cells-per-guide ratio)"))
p_runtime[[1]] <- p_runtime[[1]] + labs(y = "Runtime (hh:mm:ss)")
p_memory[[1]]  <- p_memory[[1]] + labs(y = "Peak memory (GB)")

legend <- get_legend(p_memory[[1]] + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
plot_grid(plot_grid(plotlist = c(p_runtime, p_memory), ncol = 2, align = "hv"),
          legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.08))
```
